title: SANSA: Unleashing the Hidden Semantics in SAM2 for Few-Shot Segmentation
mechanism: A light adapter makes SAM2 features semantic (not instance-tracking), then SAM2 memory attention matches support to query; supports point, box and scribble prompts.
evidence: R: SOTA on generalisation-oriented FSS benchmarks, beats generalist in-context models, faster and smaller than prior methods (natural-image benchmarks only).
adaptation: Same pipeline as GFDS SAM2 mode but semantic matching suits cracks that differ in shape between cells; optionally re-train the adapter episodically on our 478 cells (pairs sharing a class), then label pool half-cells and run the K-shot track.
min_experiment: Within G0: SANSA (off-the-shelf and EL-episodic adapter) vs GFDS SAM2 video mode vs house PF ensemble on val54+F51+H36; metric H36 inactive IoU and crack relF1@2; kill if not above SAM2 video mode and not above house on any class.
prior_overlap: none; SAM2 Hiera-T was only linear-probed frozen (no gain), never used as a matcher or labeller.
